messages:
rachel: FYI candidates in EMEA interviews this morning reported there was no scorecard attached to their calendar invites. Interviewers also said they couldn't find the scoring form in the invite. Anyone on scheduler side seeing errors?

tom: seeing repeated 413 errors from calendar-webhook when trying to POST invites with attachments. looks like attachments are getting too big and the provider rejects them.

ops-bot: ops-bot: calendar-webhook: POST /integrations/google/events 413 Payload Too Large for request_id=evt-2171112222-1 size_bytes=291204 provider_limit=262144

priya: we recently added candidate CV + portfolio zipped into the interview packet for on-site panels. that likely bumped size. scheduler was attaching a full PDF scorecard + candidate-pack.zip by default when send_packet=true.

hiring-coordinator: confirmed: default "include_packet" flag was flipped on for new reqs in EMEA last week per product request. didn't realize calendar providers have strict size caps.

tom: temporary mitigation: scheduler can stop embedding attachments and only include a short secure link to S3. PR in flight: scheduling/patches#128 — switches to link-only for invites older than 2026-12-01.

rachel: can we patch it faster? EMEA interviews start in an hour and panels will miss scoring flow.

priya: I can flip the feature flag to disable embedding for all regions for the next 24h. that will preserve downstream analytics but avoid webhook failures. doing it now.

ops-bot: ops-bot: feature-flag service: toggle include_packet_embed -> OFF for scope=global by priya at 2026-04-01T09:12:05Z

hiring-coordinator: thanks. can someone re-send invites to panels so interviewers get the scorecard link in the body?

tom: sure. I'll enqueue a resend job for affected events. job_id=resend-2171112222-2 ETA ~12m. will attach only the S3 link.

rachel: also, please add a validation in the scheduler to reject invites when total attachments_size > provider_limit with a clear log message. the silent 413s made triage slow.

priya: on it. adding a pre-send check + metric (calendar.attachment.size_rejected) and an alert.

ops-bot: ops-bot: job queued resend-2171112222-2 status=queued

tom: quick note for interviewer training: update the "before you join" checklist to say "open the scorecard link in the invite and save a local copy if you plan to score offline". will add to playbook.

hiring-coordinator: looping in recruiting-systems to run a one-off backfill for invites sent between 2026-03-28..2026-04-01 where include_packet was true. we'll post affected interview ids in #hiring-ops when job completes.

priya: follow-up action items: 1) prod feature-flag toggle (done), 2) scheduler pre-send validation PR scheduling/patches#129, 3) resend job (resend-2171112222-2), 4) playbook update + comms to interviewers.

rachel: perfect. thanks for the quick response everyone :pray: 

ops-bot: ops-bot: resend-2171112222-2 started, expected 13 events to be updated.

hiring-coordinator: i'll DM interviewers for the 13 updated panels to double-check they received the link. if anyone still missing the form after that, escalate to recruiting-systems.

priya: will follow up to make the scheduler validation a high-priority bug for the next sprint.

rachel: closing the loop here. if this recurs let's schedule a short postmortem and consider shrinking default packet contents.
